description: Standard oil filter for gasoline engines. High-capacity design with anti-drain-back valve.
Premium extended-life oil filter with synthetic media. Rated for 15,000 km intervals.
Panel air filter, dry-type. High dust capacity for extended service life.
Front brake pad set, ceramic formulation. Low dust, low noise, OE equivalent performance.
Rear brake pad set, ceramic formulation. With integrated wear sensor slots.
Front vented brake rotor, cast iron. OE replacement, cross-drilled pattern.
Iridium-tip spark plug. Extended service interval, OE heat range.
Iridium-tip spark plug for 6-cylinder applications. OE heat range.
Upstream oxygen sensor, wideband. Addresses DTC P0420 catalyst efficiency fault.
Downstream oxygen sensor. Monitors catalyst conversion efficiency post-cat.
Direct-fit catalytic converter. OE substrate loading. Addresses P0420 catalyst below threshold.
Coil-on-plug ignition coil. Addresses P0300 random/multiple cylinder misfire.
Direct fuel injector. Remanufactured to OE spec. Addresses P0171 fuel system lean fault.
Hot-wire MAF sensor. Addresses P0171 and related lean-condition codes.
Front-left ABS wheel speed sensor. Active Hall-effect type. Addresses C0035.
Front-right ABS wheel speed sensor. Matches DMS-PT011-ABS-SENS-FL specification.
Body CAN module, remanufactured. Addresses U0100 lost communication with ECM/PCM.
Steering clock spring / contact reel. Addresses B0001 driver-side air bag circuit fault.
Dual-track throttle position sensor. Drive-by-wire compatible.
3-bar MAP sensor for turbocharged applications.
NTC coolant temperature sensor. 2-wire connector, brass housing.
Intake VVT oil control solenoid. Addresses P0010/P0011 cam timing codes.
Electric EGR valve with position feedback. Complete assembly with gasket.
OE-equivalent turbocharger assembly. Variable geometry vane type.
Front-left complete strut assembly with spring and mount. OE-equivalent valving.
Front-right complete strut assembly with spring and mount.
Rear-left shock absorber, twin-tube gas pressure.
Front-left lower control arm with ball joint. Powder-coated steel.
Left outer tie rod end. Heavy-duty ball stud with grease fitting.
Remanufactured hydraulic power steering pump with reservoir.
Complete timing belt kit: belt, tensioner, idler, water pump. OE replacement intervals.
Timing chain kit with guides, tensioner and seals for single-cam engines.
In-tank electric fuel pump assembly with sender unit and strainer.
Remanufactured alternator, 140A output. OE mounting pattern.
Remanufactured starter motor, 1.4kW. Gear-reduction type.
Remanufactured A/C compressor with new clutch. Variable displacement.
Front wiper blade, beam-style, 26-inch. All-season silicone.
Cabin air filter with activated carbon layer. Pollen and odor filtration.
Automatic transmission service kit: filter, gasket, O-ring.
Rear differential pinion seal. PTFE lip, nitrile body.
Front-left CV axle shaft assembly, remanufactured. New CV boots and clamps.
Left headlamp assembly, composite housing. Halogen H7/H1 dual-beam.
Engine thermostat with housing. Opening temperature 87°C.
Engine water pump with metal impeller and installation gasket.
Replacement radiator, all-aluminum construction with plastic tanks.
Evaporative emission purge solenoid valve. Normally-closed design.
Evaporative emission vent valve. Canister side vent control.
Positive crankcase ventilation valve. Spring-loaded steel construction.
Fuel rail pressure regulator, vacuum-referenced. Addresses lean/rich fault codes.
Stepper-motor idle air control valve for throttle-body injection.
Flat-response broadband knock sensor. Single-element piezoelectric.
Hall-effect camshaft position sensor, intake bank 1.
Magnetoresistive crankshaft position sensor. Addresses misfire-related codes P0300+.
Variable tumble control system solenoid valve. Intake manifold runner control.
Electric secondary air injection pump. Cold-start emissions control.
Remanufactured PCM/ECM, pre-programmed to VIN. Requires dealer scan-tool activation.
Transmission control module, remanufactured. Addresses shift quality and U0100-related faults.
ABS/ESC control module, remanufactured. Addresses C0035 and related ABS DTCs.
Driver airbag module assembly. Addresses B0001 airbag circuit faults.
Body control module, remanufactured. Controls lighting, windows, door locks.
CAN bus gateway/router module. Bridges multiple vehicle networks. Addresses U-code network faults.
Front-left hub bearing assembly, generation 3. Integrated ABS sensor ring.
Left front sway bar link with ball joints. Heavy-duty rubber bushings.
Front-left door lock actuator with integrated position sensor.
Fuel vapor charcoal canister. Addresses EVAP system leak codes.
Electronic accelerator pedal module with dual TPS sensors. Drive-by-wire.
Vacuum brake booster, remanufactured. 9-inch single diaphragm.
Dual-circuit brake master cylinder with reservoir. Remanufactured.
Rear wheel cylinder, drum brake. Rubber honed bore, stainless hardware.
Front-left flexible brake hose, DOT compliant rubber construction.
Front-left brake caliper, remanufactured single-piston sliding type.
Front-left power window motor and regulator assembly.
HVAC blower motor assembly with cage. Quiet operation brushless design.
Automatic transmission shift solenoid kit, all solenoids. Addresses shift quality faults.
Engine oil pressure warning switch. Opens at <10 PSI.
Engine oil cooler assembly, brazed aluminum. Integrated oil filter adapter.
Upper intake manifold, remanufactured. Includes gaskets and hardware.
Exhaust manifold with catalytic pre-converter. Stainless steel construction.
Engine oil pan, steel with drain plug. Includes gasket.
Valve cover gasket set with grommets and spark plug well seals.
Multi-layer steel head gasket. Cylinder 1-4.
Engine piston ring set, standard bore. Three rings per piston: compression, wiper, oil control.
Standard-clearance main bearing set. Tri-metal construction.
Standard-clearance connecting rod bearing set. Bi-metal aluminum/steel.
Transmission mount, rubber-to-metal bonded. Hydraulic damping.
Left engine mount, hydraulic type. Reduces high-frequency vibration.
